description: Off-by-one in the nginx resolver allows a DNS-forged-UDP attacker to overwrite 1 byte of heap memory — worker crash or potential code execution (nginx 0.6.18–1.20.x).
impact: Worker crash or potential code execution via DNS-forged UDP response targeting the nginx resolver.
preconditions: nginx resolver enabled (use_resolver directive in nginx.conf)
attacker can forge DNS UDP responses to the nginx resolver

description: HTTP/2 Data Dribble: WINDOW_UPDATE frames with small increments allow remote CPU exhaustion (nginx 1.9.5–1.17.2 with ngx_http_v2_module).
impact: Remote CPU exhaustion via HTTP/2 WINDOW_UPDATE flood, causing denial of service.
preconditions: HTTP/2 listen directive enabled on the vhost

description: HTTP/2 zero-length headers cause unbounded memory growth — remote memory exhaustion (nginx 1.9.5–1.17.2 with ngx_http_v2_module).
impact: Remote memory exhaustion via zero-length HTTP/2 headers, causing denial of service.
preconditions: HTTP/2 listen directive enabled on the vhost

description: Stack-based buffer overflow in ngx_http_parse_chunked in nginx 1.3.9–1.4.0 allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service or execute arbitrary code via crafted chunked transfer encoding.
impact: Remote code execution or crash via crafted chunked transfer encoding.
preconditions: HTTP chunked transfer encoding requests are processed
